processNotes: The routing is inferred; no historical routing is supplied.
The manufactured tubes, stays, and fork are assumed available as completed components; their production is outside this draft.

The supplied BOM does not establish exact joint geometry, decal placement, or fork retention hardware. The illustration is schematic, and the fork is kept with the frame pending a documented mounting method.
variantNotes: The representative product is red, size 44. The other supplied variants are red in sizes 48, 52, 58, and 60.

All five variants have the same listed direct component IDs, quantities, and units; no variant-specific component substitutions are shown. Size-specific geometry is not supplied and must not be inferred from shared component IDs.
The catalog description mentions a 60 cm frame; that description is not a size specification for the representative size 44.

100161.title: Frame component arrangement
guidance: Arrange 1 EA Top Tube (Product Number TO-2301), 1 EA Seat Tube (Product Number ST-9828), 1 EA Down Tube (Product Number DT-2377), and 1 EA Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019) in an assumed frame alignment jig. See the schematic arrangement in illustration 100161.
Account for 2 EA Chain Stays (Product Number CS-2812) and 4 EA Seat Stays (Product Number SS-2985); position them for the rear frame arrangement. Their exact attachment geometry is not supplied.
